text:
marta_cs: Week0 onboarding check for Felix Courier private VPC. Audit logs showing files in S3 but downstream SIEM has no events. Likely causes: KMS permissions, forwarder assume-role, or audit export sampling. @felix_courierlane can you share the forwarder role ARN and collector account?

felix_courierlane: Collector account 9988776655. Forwarder role arn:aws:iam::9988776655:role/flx-splunk-forwarder. We deployed last night, no obvious errors in our agent logs besides empty batches.

vikram_infra: Two quick checks: 1) KMS key policy must allow kms:Decrypt for that role. 2) If role is cross-account ensure the trust policy lists arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-forwarder or our account root. Also confirm encryption context.

anya_sre: Also verify Console > Observability > Audit export sampling isn't set to 0. We saw cases where default sampling stayed at 0 and caused silent gaps.

marta_cs: Action items: @felix confirm KMS key ARN and sampling; @vikram will share snippet for trust policy and KMS policy. I'll log a week0 blocker and add a renewal-watch flag.

opsbot: Ticket CS-8120 created: "Felix Courier audit missing in SIEM  KMS/IAM/sampling" https://redwood.internal/tickets/CS-8120

felix_courierlane: KMS key arn: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:112233445566:key/ff-cc-11. Sampling was set to 0 (oops). I'll update sampling to 5% and check key policy.

vikram_infra: Minimal KMS statement we recommend: ```json
{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::9988776655:role/flx-splunk-forwarder"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],"Resource":"*"}
``` Also trust policy should allow our forwarder principal and include external-id if used.

felix_courierlane: Sampling bumped to 5%. Policy already included forwarder but lacked kms:GenerateDataKey*. Added it and replaying backlog now.

anya_sre: If you still see failures, check CloudTrail for KMS Deny entries and the agent logs for EncryptionContext mismatch.

felix_courierlane: Replay shows events now indexed in SIEM. No CloudTrail denies. Closing CS-8120 in monitoring state.

marta_cs: Week0 health moved to yellow, renewal risk low but we'll follow-up in 2 weeks. Adding onboarding retro note: default sampling should be 5% for first 48h and include kms:GenerateDataKey* in key policy template.

felix_courierlane: Thanks everyone, will add notes to our runbook.
